title: Spindle Orientation Failure — Tool Change Blocked
description: Spindle failed to reach orientation position within timeout (5 s). Orientation error P006 = {val} deg (limit ±0.5 deg). Tool change cycle aborted to prevent ATC arm collision.
probable_cause: Encoder signal loss, orientation proximity switch failure, or mechanical brake malfunction.
diagnostic_steps: Verify orientation switch target disk alignment
Test orientation cycle manually in JOG mode
Review parameter P082 for last NC block executed
remedy: Replace encoder or repair signal cable. Re-teach orientation position parameter. Re-run tool change acceptance cycle TCS-TEST-002.
required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.
escalation_path: If SPN-CR-003 is not addressed (immediate machine stop. do not restart without authorised technician inspection.), the fault will escalate in this order: TCS-CR-001, then SPN-MJ-003, then CNC-MD-011. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
